root.label: US warns France and Germany over diesel reserves

events.label: US warns France and Germany over diesel reserves

slots.name: diesel export restrictions status
slots.sentence: Reuters reported on Thursday that the Trump administration had told Germany and France to draw down emergency diesel inventories or face a potential US diesel export ban, according to three people close to the discussions.

events.label: US demands European diesel stock release

slots.name: diesel barrels demanded
slots.sentence: The US had demanded large European countries including France and Germany release 100 million barrels of diesel within a 20-day window, one of the sources told Reuters on Friday.

slots.name: diesel release volume
slots.sentence: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington had done its share of an agreement struck in March among International Energy Agency (IEA) members in releasing 172 million barrels of US diesel.

slots.name: status of release
slots.sentence: The United States on Thursday told its European allies, particularly Germany and France, to "immediately" release their strategic reserves of diesel to help lower the soaring price of the refined fuel.

slots.name: IEA request status
slots.sentence: Germany's Economy Ministry, meanwhile, said the IEA has not yet asked Berlin to release diesel stocks.
